chemistry-killer-03.title: Konservasaun masa, proporsaun konstante, reasaun ezotérmika no endotérmika
chemistry-killer-03.topic: Konservasaun masa, proporsaun konstante, reasaun ezotérmika no endotérmika
chemistry-killer-03.goal: Analyze the underlying scientific principles and deduce the correct conclusion.
chemistry-killer-03.material: Hatama nitrojéniu ($\mathrm{N_2}$) 14 g no hidrojéniu ($\mathrm{H_2}$) 4 g iha resipiente no halo reaje kompletu hodi forma amónia ($\mathrm{NH_3}$). Reasaun mak $\mathrm{N_2 + 3H_2 \rightarrow 2NH_3}$ no masa atómika H=1, N=14, no reasaun akontese to'o reajente ida gasta hotu. Oinsá mak liga loos tuir orden masa (g) husi $\mathrm{NH_3}$ ne'ebé forma depois reasaun no valór ne'ebé konverte volume gás hotu iha resipiente depois reasaun ba kondisaun padraun (STP, 1 mol = 22,4 L)?
chemistry-killer-03.thinking.0: Konservasaun masa, proporsaun konstante, reasaun ezotérmika no endotérmika
chemistry-killer-03.s.s1.prompt: Hatama nitrojéniu ($\mathrm{N_2}$) 14 g no hidrojéniu ($\mathrm{H_2}$) 4 g iha resipiente no halo reaje kompletu hodi forma amónia ($\mathrm{NH_3}$). Reasaun mak $\mathrm{N_2 + 3H_2 \rightarrow 2NH_3}$ no masa atómika H=1, N=14, no reasaun akontese to'o reajente ida gasta hotu. Oinsá mak liga loos tuir orden masa (g) husi $\mathrm{NH_3}$ ne'ebé forma depois reasaun no valór ne'ebé konverte volume gás hotu iha resipiente depois reasaun ba kondisaun padraun (STP, 1 mol = 22,4 L)?
chemistry-killer-03.s.s1.explain:
Pasu 1: Mol. $\mathrm{N_2}$ 14 g ÷ 28 g/mol = 0,5 mol, $\mathrm{H_2}$ 4 g ÷ 2 g/mol = 2 mol.
Pasu 2: Kompara valór fahe ho koefisiente. $\mathrm{N_2}$: 0,5/1 = 0,5, $\mathrm{H_2}$: 2/3 ≈ 0,67. $\mathrm{N_2}$ ho valór kiik liu mak reajente limitante.
Pasu 3: Se $\mathrm{N_2}$ 0,5 mol reaje hotu, $\mathrm{H_2}$ 1,5 mol gasta no $\mathrm{NH_3}$ 1,0 mol forma. Masa = 1,0 × 17 = 17 g. $\mathrm{H_2}$ ne'ebé hela = 2 − 1,5 = 0,5 mol.
Pasu 4: Total mol gás depois reasaun = 1,0 + 0,5 = 1,5 mol → volume STP = 1,5 × 22,4 = 33,6 L.
Resposta: 17 g, 33,6 L (c). (Resposta sala: 22,4 L mak valór ne'ebé la tau matan ba H2 ne'ebé hela, 34 g mak valór ne'ebé la multiplika koefisiente 2 ho mol NH3 no konfunde mol N2·H2, 8,5 g mak valór ne'ebé hanoin sala N2 : NH3 = 1 : 1)
chemistry-killer-03.s.s2.prompt: Which scenario demonstrates the correct real-world application of this principle?
chemistry-killer-03.s.s2.explain: The fundamental principles of this inquiry are widely implemented in modern technology.
